## The open-source alternative to Grok Bot, Muse, dots and Cue

Four closed personal-agent products shipped in seven weeks of 2026, and each one keeps the model, the computer and your data on its maker's side of the line. OpenMausBot is the open-source version of that shape: a team of agents in a chat app, each with its own model, its own computer and its own connected apps, running on your machine under Apache 2.0. If you searched for an open Muse, open dots, an open-source Grok Bot, an open Instinct or an open Cue, this is the repository. [...] ## Repository files navigation

# OpenMausBot

The open-source Grok Bot alternative: your own team of AI bots, in a chat app.

openmausbot.com  ·  Download  ·  Open source Grok Bot alternative, compared

OpenMausBot is an open-source Grok Bot alternative: an independent project inspired by Grok Bot, and the open-source alternative to Meta Muse, OpenAI dots and Cue by Manus — bring-your-own-agent, local-first, on the models you already have. Also known as MausBot; formerly OpenGrokBot. Not affiliated with xAI, Meta, OpenAI or Manus.

Every bot in the sidebar is a real agent — Claude or Codex running locally under the hood — with its own personality, its own model, its own cloud computer, and its own connected apps. Talk to them like contacts. Watch them work. Approve what matters. [...] Usage analytics are optional and anonymous: product events and a once-a-day count of what is set up, never keys, names, addresses or conversations. Turn them off in Settings → General → Usage analytics; `docs/analytics.md` lists every event and property.

## Support the project

OpenMausBot is free and open source. If it does real work for you, you can support its development through GitHub Sponsors with a one-time contribution or a monthly sponsorship. Your support helps fund ongoing development and maintenance; OpenMausBot remains free and open source.

## Run from a terminal or on a server

With Node 24 or newer, install once and run:

```
npm install -g openmausbot openmausbot
```

# Best Open Source Grok Bot Alternatives

By Suraj·Reviewed ·Verified

Grok Bot is xAI's agentic product, not the Grok chatbot. You set up bots once, each with its own memory and history like a teammate with a name, all working on one shared cloud computer with a browser, a filesystem and a terminal. Maybe you saw that it needs a paid Cursor or SuperGrok plan with no free tier and wondered whether a self-hosted stack can do the same work. Eight projects get close, and I ranked them by how much of that setup they keep. Some give every bot its own machine, some live in Slack or Telegram, and a couple keep an audit trail behind a policy gate.
